# Unit Test Report — KilosUnlad

**Plan reference:** Section 12.1.2, Unit Testing ("isolated functional verification of deterministic algorithms: Canonical JSON serialization, Haversine geofence calculation, and SHAP attribution extraction"), and the Sprint 1–6 items of `docs/integration/SCRUM_INTEGRATION_PLAN.md` plus its post-plan scope (Sprint 7).
**Executed:** 2026-10-14 on the final build (`main` after PR #38). Each test file was run on its own, so results are grouped by file. Raw output (TAP / pytest) is in [`evidence/unit/`](evidence/unit/).
**Generated by:** `docs/testing/tools/build_test_docs.py` from that raw output. Existing `UT-nnn` IDs are kept; new cases get the next free number, so an ID never changes meaning.
**Companion documents:** [`SECTION12_TEST_RESULTS.md`](SECTION12_TEST_RESULTS.md) (TC-01 to TC-24, defects, UAT) and [`MASTER_TEST_CATALOG.md`](MASTER_TEST_CATALOG.md) (every test in the project, by ID).

## Summary

| Result | Count |
| --- | ---: |
| Test cases executed (top-level) | **208** |
| Passed | **208** |
| Failed | **0** |
| Skipped | **0** |
| Additional subtests inside component tests (↳) | **66**, all PASS |

**How these numbers match the runners' own counters:**
- **Server:** `npm test` with every opt-in suite enabled reports `# tests 175, pass 175, skipped 0` (`evidence/unit/server_full.tap`). That figure counts top-level cases, subtests and nested subtests together. The two Docker tests (`auditRoleCompatibility`, the outage case in `databaseLifecycle`) ran this time, so nothing was skipped.
- **Client:** `npm test` runs `auth` and `submissionContract` (69 tests); `npm run test:pwa` runs `pwa` on the build output (2).
- **Python:** four pytest files (ML unit, Sprint 2 mechanics, seed mapping, UAT scorer).

**Runner environment:** `RUN_WORKFLOW_MONGO_TESTS=1 MONGOD_PATH=<mongod> TEST_MONGO_URI=<replica set> RUN_AUDIT_ROLE_TESTS=1 RUN_DB_RECOVERY_TESTS=1` (the last two need Docker).

### The three algorithms named in the plan

| Algorithm | Where it is tested | Result |
| --- | --- | :---: |
| Canonical JSON serialization (and SHA-256 entry hashing) | `server/test/cryptoHelper.test.js`: key order does not change the JSON or the hash; falsy values and array order kept; Date and ISO string hash the same; known SHA-256 vector | **PASS (5/5)** |
| Haversine geofence calculation | `server/test/geoFence.test.js`: GeoJSON longitude-first order; inclusive 250 m boundary on the unrounded distance; malformed coordinates fail closed; antipodes and date line | **PASS (4/4)** |
| SHAP attribution extraction | `data-pipeline/scripts/test_section12_ml_unit.py`: top 3 ranked by absolute weight and signed; weights are the predicted class's attributions; attributions plus base value equal the model margin; probabilities sum to 1 | **PASS (5/5)** |

### Retired IDs

A test whose behaviour changed gets a new ID; the old one is never reused.

| Retired | Old test case | Replaced by | Why |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| UT-040 | only the four documented forward transitions are accepted | UT-199 | DECISION-012 added two returns to ACTIVE_COMPLIANT (retention, granted appeal) |
| UT-107 | dispatch puts assignments before collapsed staff details and identifies sample data | UT-203 | DECISION-010: the dispatch screen loads server records only |
| UT-111 | dashboard separates live workload from samples and has one analytics selector | UT-204 | DECISION-010: the regional snapshot comes from the server |
| UT-120 | policy settings clearly identifies non-persistent previews | UT-205 | DECISION-010: policy settings is read-only and loads the server policy |

**Levels:**
- **Unit:** one function or module in isolation, no database or network.
- **Component (disposable replica set):** the Express app runs in-process against a throwaway MongoDB replica set started by the test itself. These sit in the server's unit suite (`npm test`), but they are closer to integration tests.
- **Component (Docker):** the test starts its own MongoDB container.

## B. Client (React PWA)

Runner: `cd client && npm test && npm run build && npm run test:pwa`
